title: Revised board files
passage:
Could you send me the revised circuit-board files?
A. Sure, I'll attach them to an email. B. The boards are two millimeters thick. C. She usually works from home.
passageZh:
你可以把修訂過的電路板檔案寄給我嗎？
A. 可以，我會把它們附在電子郵件裡。
B. 電路板厚兩毫米。
C. 她通常在家工作。
